ai_summary: Aaron Industries Limited has announced the strategic expansion of its product portfolio with the introduction of fire-rated steel doors, diversifying beyond its core elevator component business into commercial and industrial fire-safety solutions. These new doors, certified with a 120-minute fire-resistance rating, aim to broaden the company's customer base and leverage existing manufacturing capabilities for long-term growth by addressing evolving safety requirements. No material financial impacts or red flags are disclosed in this product launch announcement.
